snippet.title: In Vino Veritas - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
In Vino Veritas is a first-person narrative horror set in an abandoned cathedral, a place where faith has left deep scars and the truth has been buried for centuries.
When a police officer goes missing during a reconnaissance mission, all search efforts are called off. You decide to go in alone.

What was meant to be a simple exploration turns into a descent into a disturbing past.
